name: Wells Fargo Visa® Credit Cards and Mastercard®

localized_names.en: Wells Fargo Visa® Credit Cards and Mastercard®

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for 12 months on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. Then 18.49%, 24.49%, or 28.49% variable based on creditworthiness. No late payment fee.

fx_fee.notes: 3% of each transaction converted to U.S. dollars.

credit_required.notes: APR tiers based on creditworthiness; typically requires good to excellent credit.

base_rate.description: 1% cash rewards on all other net purchases

categories.label: Self-care (gym, fitness studios, spas, beauty/barber shops)
Planet-friendly purchases (EV charging, public transit, secondhand stores)

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem through Wells Fargo Rewards for cash back, travel, gift cards, and more. 4% cash rewards = 1% base plus 3% bonus. Cash equivalents do not earn cash rewards.

signup_bonus.description: $100 cash rewards bonus after spending $500 in qualifying purchases in the first 3 months.

benefits.title: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Up to $600 per claim against damage, theft, and unintended separation when paying monthly phone bill with eligible card. $25 deductible. Max 2 paid claims per 12 months.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Reimbursed for covered damage or theft when paying for rental cars with eligible card.

benefits.title: Zero Liability Protection
benefits.description: Not held responsible for promptly reported unauthorized transactions.

benefits.title: Credit Close-Up
benefits.description: Free access to check and track your FICO Score without impacting your credit score.

notes: Issued by Wells Fargo. World Elite Mastercard. 3% foreign transaction fee. Signup bonus is $100 cash rewards after $500 spend (NOT 20,000 points — that was the Autograph card's bonus).
